requirements.description: Every future expansion batch (B2+) must author entities strictly under V2 schema (Full Canonical, Reference Only, Supported, Non-Entity Literal) prior to canonical promotion.
Promotion requires 100% parity across facts, entities, practical memory, teaching connections, and documentary maps between canonical JSON and local SQLite sovereign mirror.
Canonical coverage may only be counted for FULL_CANONICAL entities explicitly mapped MAPPED_EXACT to AMC targets.
All promoted artifacts must be immutably recorded in AETERNUM_CERTIFIED_ARTIFACT_HASH_LEDGER.
